scope: Production Dart worker and GGML VAD on Windows using the explicit upstream reference runtime. Not shipped Android/iOS binaries or phone performance.
normalization: Same NFKC/Han-CER/Latin-WER rules as evaluate_transcription.py; no script conversion
corpusSelection: First 30 rows per language with duration >= 2 seconds; round-robin across first up to three numeric speaker IDs in validation split, preserving source row order per speaker; exhausted speakers skipped; chosen before inference
corpusAttribution: HKUST CAiRE; Lovenia et al., ASCEND (LREC 2022)
pcmReadPolicy: Original floor-ms reader; later exact-tail fix requires its own validation
